content:
Conditional ﬁltering allows you to control when your AWS Lambda processor invokes the Lambda
function based on speciﬁc conditions in event data. This is particularly useful when you want to
selectively process certain types of events while ignoring others.
The following example conﬁguration uses conditional ﬁltering:
processors:
- aws_lambda:
function_name: "my-lambda-function"
aws:
region: "region"
lambda_when: "/sourceIp == 10.10.10.10"
